notes:
NetSathi apps 0.2.4

- The manager's day: each type's tickets and what each person did, one day at a time, back a week; every number opens its tickets, and a person's day unfolds into their steps
- A closed ticket says how it ended: back online, the technician's report, the office's reason, renewed or collected
- Send to field and Send to office, with the reason asked on the page; a sent ticket is released to wait on that side
- A technician sends a job that is not field work to the office, and raises another ticket from the job with the customer filled in
- A No-internet complaint shows what the portal and the fibre said when it was raised, with Read again and Router is on
- Resolved on a complaint, and It works now in the customer app: the complaint closes on its own once the line has stayed up, and says when
- The office changes a ticket's category; a technician raises another ticket instead
